Project/internal page class tokens (internal-* block) —

UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

INTERNAL_CLASSES

Internals (project-detail) page classes on the internal-* block family: internal root, internal-main item grid, internal-description prose block, internal-extra scroll strip, internal-footer related/notes area, internal-expand trigger. ZTF_VIDEO is a standalone modifier (zoom-to-fill) applied alongside items, not an internal-* descendant.

INTERNAL_FOOTER_ITEMS_DIVIDER_CANVAS

WebGPU overlay canvas for the divider sheen (divider-sheen widget).

PROJECT_CLASSES

Frozen project class-name map — sole declaration site for these tokens; consumers read members and never re-declare the strings (zero-hardcoding rules 4–5). Object.freeze makes the token contract immutable at runtime.
